description: Capability for the main window: save/open dialogs, writing exported files, opening external links in the system browser, calling the free AI providers (Pollinations cloud, plus Ollama / LM Studio on localhost) without CORS limits, reaching Google Drive / GitHub for the optional 'save to your own storage' account feature, reaching App Store Connect / Google Play for the direct-to-store screenshot upload, and opening and placing the detached panel windows (Properties, Layers, History, Versions) on whichever display the user picks. allow-destroy is what lets this window close AT ALL: Tauri prevents the native close whenever a window has a JS close-requested listener (this one has, for the final project save), and the API's own onCloseRequested calls destroy() to finish the job.
